# Line startup - Hot Forge line (SOP-P1-L1-01)

Purpose
- Reminder for operators prior to initiating the hot forge line following SOP-P1-L1-01.

Pre-start checks
- Verify required PPE is worn and intact: heat-resistant gloves, face protection, hearing protection, and flame-retardant clothing.
- Confirm area is clear of nonessential personnel and trip hazards.
- Inspect die seating and clamps for cleanliness and correct orientation. Remove loose scale and debris.
- Check lubrication reservoirs and delivery lines for continuity and proper fluid level indication. Confirm no leaks.
- Ensure process sensors and interlocks are connected and functional. Confirm communication to line controls and quality station.

Startup sequence highlights
- Announce startup intent to the line team and quality checkpoint. Use established hand signals or radio.
- Energize heating circuits and allow controls to reach steady state per SOP. Observe control feedback and alarm panels for abnormal indications.
- Bring conveyors and feeders online with minimum material load. Monitor part entry for correct timing and alignment.
- Run initial trial parts and visually confirm part geometry and surface condition before escalating throughput.
- Monitor dies for secure thermal expansion behavior and listen for unusual noises. Stop and inspect if fit or motion is abnormal.

Immediate actions for abnormal conditions
- Engage emergency stop if safety is compromised. Notify maintenance and line lead.
- Log all deviations in the shift log and tag suspect parts for quarantine.
- Do not resume normal production until cause is identified and cleared per SOP.
